facts.text: Mount Pleasant sits in central Westchester County, roughly 27 miles north of Manhattan, making it a short drive into the New York metropolitan area.
Within its borders, Mount Pleasant contains the hamlets of Valhalla, Hawthorne, Pocantico Hills, Thornwood, and the villages of Pleasantville, Sleepy Hollow, plus part of Briarcliff Manor.
The town hall sits in the hamlet of Mount Pleasant, serving as the administrative center for the entire town.
In 2017, Westchester County unveiled a $1.2 billion biotech hub in Valhalla, adjacent to Westchester Medical Center, projected to create 12,000 jobs.
Mount Pleasant borders the Hudson River to the west and the Kensico Reservoir to the east, giving it scenic waterfront and waterway access.
The line between Greenburgh and Mount Pleasant follows Andre Brook, marking the boundary between the villages of Tarrytown and Sleepy Hollow.
